name: Archive Studio Elementor
author: wpcraftnet

sections.description: Create stunning blog archive pages with Elementor using Grid, Masonry, and Portrait layouts—fully customizable styles and controls. ** Description ** This addons includes 4 professionally designed archive layouts: ✔️ Grid Layout ✔️ Masonry Layout ✔️ Portrait Layout ✔️ Portrait Card Layout Each layout includes dedicated controllers and styling options, giving full control over archive pages spacing, typography, images, pagination more. This plugin also supports advanced pagination styles, letting users define how archive navigation appears—classic pagination, load more, infinite scroll, numbers, next/prev buttons, etc. ** Key Features ** ✔️ 4 Modern Archive Layouts ✔️ Separate Controller for Each Layout ✔️ Full Style Customization (Typography, Colors, Spacing, etc.) ✔️ Advanced Pagination Options ✔️ Works with Any Theme ✔️ Optimized for Elementor & Elementor Pro ✔️ Fast Loading & SEO-Friendly Output ✔️ Lightweight & No Unnecessary Scripts ✔️ Developer-friendly structure for adding more layouts in future. Whether you’re a designer or developer, you can easily create beautiful archive pages that perfectly match your brand. ** Pageination ** 5 types paigination are available you can choose among them. – Select pagination – Next / Previous – Numerica Pagination – Infinite (Pro) – Load More (Pro) ** Features & Benefits ** ** – Dynamic Layout Selection ** Users can choose any archive layout, and the plugin automatically applies it on the frontend. ** – Global Customization Support ** Customize archive elements such as: – Featured images – Titles – Meta info – Excerpt – Read More button – Spacing & padding – Border, radius, shadow ** – Extendable Layout System ** Developers can add additional layouts with separate controllers. ** – Elementor-Native Controls ** All settings use Elementor’s built-in Control Manager and styling structure.
